description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Eversource Energy is seeking an Associate Software Engineer to join its software engineering team. The role performs basic end-to-end engineering tasks, including analysis, development, testing, debugging, configuration, incident investigation, documentation, monitoring, and implementation based on user or system specifications. The engineer also develops and configures Engineering Operations systems and collaborates with managed service provider teams to execute backlog assignments.
Associate Software Engineer configuring engineering operations systems, prioritizing service-provider backlogs, and improving processes

Responsibilities:
• Works with direct supervision on projects / assignments. Sets objectives for own area of responsibility to meet the objectives or goals of projects and assignments
• Develops and configures customizations and configurations of various Engineering Operations systems
• Works with managed service provider teams to prioritize and execute backlog assignments
• Problems and issues faced are general and may require understanding of broader set of issues
• Problems may span a range of issues or work areas and are typically solved through exercise of discretion and / or judgment, drawing from prior experiences, with analysis of the issue
• Responsible for making minor changes or enhancements in systems and processes to solve problems or improve effectiveness of work area
• Communicates with parties within and outside of own team
• Explains policies, practices, and procedures of the work area to others within the organization, influencing decision- makers with recommended courses of action
• Must be available to work emergency restoration assignment as required
• Must be available to travel between MA/CT/NH as necessary

Requirements:
• Eversource will not offer immigration-related sponsorship for this position (e.g., H-1B, O-1, J-1, TN, E-3, etc.). Applicants requiring visa sponsorship to start employment with Eversource will not be considered
• Effectively uses code version control systems such as git
• Understands basic programming and OOP concepts (languages may include Python, JSON, C++)
• Understands core application development patterns
• Experienced using data structures
• Familiar with traditional data stores
• Familiar with REST API syntax and tools for documenting and testing the REST APIs such as Postman
• Familiar with Agile methodology
• Theoretical knowledge of work area
• Ability to work autonomously with limited supervision
• Displays strong work ethic
• Understands direction provided and implements assigned tasks effectively
• Displays Project/team level impact
• Troubleshoots simple engineering problems by checking logs, using developer tools and debugger effectively
• Able to use existing knowledge of algorithms, structures and patterns to design and implement solutions of light to moderate complexity
• Objectively evaluates whether they've met their goals
• Communicates effectively during meetings
• Completes work or raises roadblocks in a timely manner
• Open to change and learning new skills to get work done
• Accepts feedback graciously and learns from experience
• Shows respect towards other team members
• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
• Minimum of 0 to 3 years of relevant experience
• Requires theoretical to advanced knowledge of work area typically obtained through University Degree combined with experience
